up: Retrieve assay information for assays targeting human single-protein CHEMBL1293274 (Eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4H) with IC50 activities measured in nM. Include assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for each activity row where the standard relation equals '=' and pChEMBL value is present. Return at most the first 1000 rows. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID in ascending order.
sql:
WITH target_activities AS (
  SELECT a.activity_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.pchembl_value, a.molecule_chembl_id, a.assay_id, a.relation
  FROM activities a
  JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
  JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
  WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293274'
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.standard_relation = '='
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
),
canon_smiles AS (
  SELECT a.activity_id, cs.canonical_smiles
  FROM target_activities a
  LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id
)
SELECT td.pref_name AS assay_target_type,
       ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
       cs.canonical_smiles,
       a.molecule_chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
       a.pchembl_value,
       a.standard_type
FROM target_activities a
LEFT JOIN cano_smiles cs ON a.activity_id = cs.activity_id
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
ORDER BY a.molecule_chembl_id, ass.chembl_id
LIMIT 1000;
